attempts.reason:
Review of PR #178 (operator session, 2026-08-29). Well-written, 790 tests + smoke green, the pure decision `shouldNudgeOnStop` is in model.js with tests, doctor warns when SubagentStop is missing, constraints (no new API call, unreadable dir → nudge, whichAttempt/env-leak gate untouched) all hold. But the mechanism does not close the loop it opens:

**BLOCKER — `ended` is never recorded in the field, so a track root that ever spawns a subagent is never nudged again for that attempt.** `subagentStopHook` (src/hook.js ~374) resolves identity via `whichAttempt(ctx.root)` with `ctx.root = repoRoot(process.cwd())`. The spike log this card cites shows every `SubagentStop` firing with cwd = `.claude/worktrees/agent-<id>` (the child worktree); only `Stop` and the root's `PreToolUse` fire at the `kb-…` checkout. `agent-<id>` does not parse as `kb-<n>-<k>`, a `--bg` daemon has no KB_TASK, and on claude-p the leaked-env path yields no identity either. Reproduced with the branch: after `preToolHook(Agent)` at kb-9-1 and `subagentStopHook` from an `agent-*` cwd, the file stays `{"started":1,"ended":0}`, exit 0, no stderr. Net effect flips "two false nudges per wave" into "zero nudges ever" — the outcome the card itself ranks worse. Fix: the child hook's env still carries `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` = the root's kb-… checkout and `session_id` = the root's; resolve the root from `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` (or payload cwd vs CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) when cwd is not a kb-* checkout. Add the test that fires SubagentStop from an `agent-*` cwd — the current tests (test/hook.test.js ~492-505) fire it from the root's own ctx, so they pass while the feature does not work. If you want to settle the spawn cwd first, a one-line logger hook writing process.cwd() on SubagentStop in a spike session does it.

**Should fix in the same pass:**
1. Lost update under a parallel wave: `bumpAgentCount` (src/hook.js ~151) is read-modify-write; two SubagentStops finishing together both read ended:0 and both write ended:1 → started > ended forever (same silent never-nudged outcome). Append one line per event (O_APPEND is atomic for short writes) or one file per agent_id, and count entries.
2. A denied `Agent` call disables the nudge: `Agent` is not in CLAUDE_TOOLS, so under dontAsk PreToolUse fires (started++) before the call is denied and no SubagentStop follows; same for a subagent aborted mid-run. Bound the suppression (cap suppressed Stops per attempt, or record only after the tool ran) so "never suppress on a guess" stays honest.
3. Merge origin/main — the branch is 20 commits behind (merge-base 2895045); two trivial conflicts: src/hook.js preToolHook head (main moved to `const id = whichAttempt(...); if (id?.source !== 'env') return 0; const n = id.n;` — keep that shape, do NOT reintroduce `process.env.KB_TASK`) and the test/model.test.js import line (keep both `deadAtRecheck` and `shouldNudgeOnStop`). A simulated merge passes 818/818.
4. Docs: README ~20 and docs/harnesses.md ~204, ~293 still say "Stop and PreToolUse"; `concepts/worker-identity.md` describes the nudge and is not updated; no wiki page for the new hook (AGENTS.md: new feature → new page); re-stamp hook-install-shapes.md and the pages behind main.

Nits: one test without KB_* env (the --bg root case, source worktree) would pin the path that matters; hooks/hooks.json (plugin) gains SubagentStop without PreToolUse (dead weight, safe direction); .kanban/sessions/*.subagents accumulate — hkb gc never cleans that directory (pre-existing).

Same branch, same PR (worktree-kb-163-2). Rerun lint/test/smoke, then `hkb finish`.

results.summary: Taught the Stop hook to tell "idle because a wave of subagents is still out" from "idle because the work is done": preToolHook now records every Agent tool call as a subagent start and the new subagentStopHook records every SubagentStop as an end, both under .kanban/sessions/<n>-<k>.subagents; stopHook asks shouldNudgeOnStop (src/model.js, pure, tested against the 2026-08-28 spike log) before nudging, and never touches the nudge counter when it suppresses. Unreadable/absent bookkeeping defaults to {started:0, ended:0} -- nudge as before, never suppress on a guess. CLAUDE_HOOKS (src/init.js) now includes SubagentStop so hkb init and the worker launch register it beside Stop and PreToolUse; hooks/hooks.json does the same for the plugin; doctor's checkHooks reports a missing SubagentStop the way it reports a missing Stop hook. Regenerated the committed kanban-worker-claude.yml (hkb init --with-actions, only the --settings line changed) and updated scripts/smoke-pack.mjs's hardcoded hook counts to match the third hook. PR: https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/178

residual_risk: MAX_SUPPRESSED_STOPS=4 is a judgment call against the 20-30 min idle-tick cadence -- a wave with an unusually long individual subagent and a short root reschedule interval could still hit it before the wave finishes, forcing one avoidable nudge (never a stuck attempt, since the two real nudges remain and worst case is one false one)

The CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR fallback trusts that env var's value outright for a session with no KB_TASK; it was measured once (2026-08-28 spike) to equal the root's own checkout, not independently verified against every Claude Code version
10 wiki pages remain stale from #144/#149-era drift and main's later commits, unrelated to this card's scope -- left for whoever owns that cleanup, same as attempt 2 noted

results.summary: Addressed the PR #178 review: subagentStopHook fired from the child's own agent-<id> worktree, whose cwd carries no KB_TASK and does not parse as kb-<n>-<k>, so whichAttempt(ctx.root) returned null and 'ended' was never recorded -- a root that ever spawned a subagent was never nudged again. It now falls back to process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (which Claude Code sets to the root session's own checkout even inside a child's turn) when the cwd itself answers nothing. Also fixed the lost-update race: the started/ended bookkeeping under .kanban/sessions/<n>-<k>.subagents moved from read-modify-write JSON to append-only lines (S/E/X), so two SubagentStops finishing together can no longer both read ended:0 and both write ended:1. And bounded the suppression itself: a denied Agent call or a subagent that dies before firing SubagentStop used to suppress every future Stop on that attempt forever; shouldNudgeOnStop (model.js) now counts consecutive suppressed Stops and nudges anyway past MAX_SUPPRESSED_STOPS (4), chosen against the 20-30 minute idle-tick cadence a track root reschedules itself on. Merged origin/main (20 commits, two conflicts: preToolHook's identity-lookup shape and the model.test.js import line -- resolved keeping both branches' additions). Re-stamped docs/wiki/concepts/worker-identity.md with a new section on the CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR fallback and bounded suppression; updated README.md and docs/harnesses.md to say three hooks (Stop/PreToolUse/SubagentStop) rather than two where they enumerated them.
